contacts.ask: How do we detect stale flow references, missing dependencies, or environment differences before import?
contacts.request: Preflight dependency report; deployment manifest; evaluation gate; recovery procedure.
contacts.bring: CloudFlow not found import; connection references; promotion path.

contacts.ask: Can tests assert hotel, reporting period, tool inputs, numerical results, permissions and channel behavior?
contacts.request: Exportable CI evidence, failure explanations and retest policy.
contacts.bring: Wrong period; forecast versus bookings; known-answer numerical case.

contacts.ask: How can a maker trace Teams error when Studio logs show success?
contacts.request: Correlated trace ID and redacted cross-product support bundle.
contacts.bring: Sanitized Teams error and successful Studio run.

contacts.ask: Can an ordinary user provision their connection in the agent without the maker portal or broad data rights?
contacts.request: Connector-specific identity/onboarding pattern; distinguish consent, provisioning, policy and rights.

contacts.people: Jed Brown; Emily Kessler; Austin Laugesen; Jordan Chodak
contacts.ask: Which GA Git/coding-agent workflow can promote DEV to PROD without maker-owned Entra app registration?
contacts.request: Licensing and feature matrix; portable deployment example.
contacts.bring: Lead Flow, environment migration, code-assisted workflow.

contacts.people: Eun Hee Kim; Power BI/Fabric IQ feature owners
contacts.ask: Can answers expose measure, filters, period, refresh and supporting query?
contacts.request: Governed semantic model and reproducible evaluation reference.

contacts.ask: Where are admission, execution identity, tool authorization, resource access and runtime approval enforced?
contacts.request: Control matrix for MCP, skills, connectors, child agents, revocation and audit.
contacts.bring: Separate membership from data access; solution-level groups.

contacts.ask: What minimum model governs numerous projects without custom process per project?
contacts.request: Reusable risk tiers; owners/backups; lifecycle gates; escalation.

contacts.people: Praveen Mantha; Gregg Barker; Lane Swenka
contacts.ask: How can business makers diagnose policy blockers without wide admin rights?
contacts.request: Approved patterns; actionable diagnostics; delegated roles; security evidence export.

contacts.people: Ken Auguillard; Kendra Springer; Trisha Sinha
contacts.ask: Who owns the authoritative inventory and cross-platform policy enforcement?
contacts.request: RACI; consistent project ID across apps, agents, flows, data and ownership.

contacts.people: Elaine Ansell; Mik Ferland; Hongfei Guo
contacts.ask: What does an E3/Premium task cost across agents, flows, data and connectors?
contacts.request: Written scenarios, attribution, budgets, limits, alerts and showback.
contacts.bring: Mixed license and shared platform costs.

contacts.people: Adrian Orth; Miti Joshi; Pratyusha Avadhanula; Bas Brekelmans
contacts.ask: When must a Cowork task/skill become an org-owned Studio agent or managed workflow?
contacts.request: Upgrade path; versioning, sharing, DLP, offboarding and production ownership.

contacts.ask: How to validate Adaptive Cards, MCP Apps and Teams rendering across hosts?
contacts.request: State, drilldowns, accessibility and regression tests.

contacts.people: Nathan Helgren; Paul Liew; Tommy Graham
contacts.ask: When should analytical data be virtual versus copied?
contacts.request: Least-privilege migration/capacity guidance; Teams lifecycle document.

contacts.ask: How to provide analytical evidence and secure paginated distribution?
How to track ingestion, freshness, exclusions and deep links for Loop retrieval?

contacts.people: Ryan Cunningham; Leon Welicki; Nirav Shah
contacts.ask: Who can sponsor an end-to-end governed maker-to-production pattern?
